title: Build an island nation and try to keep it from falling apart looking for beta testers
author: Cut-Kooky
selftext:
I’m looking for feedback on **The Social Contract**, a browser strategy game where you build and lead an island nation through 50 rounds.  
Design your flag, build districts, manage public services, and handle tough decisions with consequences. You can also trade, form alliances, and go to war with other players.

**Play:** [https://social-contract-game.mcamp830.chatgpt.site](https://social-contract-game.mcamp830.chatgpt.site/)

Free to play on desktop or mobile. No download or ChatGPT account needed. Choose a username and save your recovery code to continue later.  
It’s an AI-assisted project and still in beta. If you have 10–15 minutes, I’d appreciate honest feedback:  
Is it clear what to do next?  
Do your choices feel meaningful?  
What gets boring or frustrating?  
Any bugs or awkward mobile controls?  
You can leave feedback here or inside the game. Thanks for testing!
